rules.statement: A GitHub Actions workflow whose job is a required status check must not use `paths`/`paths-ignore` filters on its `pull_request` trigger; it runs on every pull request and decides inside a first job, from the changed files, whether the gated job runs, so that a skipped job still reports success.
rules.why: A path-filtered workflow that does not run leaves its required check pending forever, which blocks the merge.
rules.check: Look for `paths:` or `paths-ignore:` under `on.pull_request` in a workflow that defines a job used as a required check, or a new gating workflow that has no change-detection job and so cannot report on every pull request. A path filter on `push` to main is fine.
